question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin adopt hybrid retrieval, and if so should it be opt-in or default-on with what fusion and fallback contract?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability gap, but code alone cannot decide official ranking semantics, config surface, index-failure behavior, or whether upgrades should change existing result ordering.

options.title: Opt-in hybrid retrieval
options.body: Add typed hybrid configuration and explicit vector/FTS fusion while preserving current vector-only ranking unless users enable it.

options.title: Default-on hybrid retrieval
options.body: Enable FTS and fused ranking for all users while documenting and testing vector-only recovery when text indexing is unavailable.

options.title: Keep official plugin vector-only
options.body: Decline the bundled behavior change and direct users needing richer LanceDB ranking to an external plugin such as the implementation linked from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48012.

recommendation.title: Opt-in hybrid retrieval
recommendation.body: Add typed hybrid configuration and explicit vector/FTS fusion while preserving current vector-only ranking unless users enable it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product-decision owner from the feature history and prior review of this exact issue.
